prompt:
Top-down editorial still photograph. A single sheet of matte uncoated off-white paper lies flat on a seamless warm stone grey (#E4DED2) paper backdrop, slightly rotated (about 4 degrees). Hard late-morning sunlight from the upper left casts a crisp, soft-edged diagonal window-light shadow across one corner of the frame.
The sheet is an agent team dashboard, a roster of AI agents coordinated by a Chief of Staff agent, built in AI & Agents Professional. It shows only the artifact's own content, never a caption or description of what it is. Printed in clean modern sans-serif typography, near-black ink, generous margins and a clear hierarchy. Visible text, spelled exactly: "Chief of Staff"; "Research Analyst · ran 4 tasks"; "Operations Assistant · 1 waiting". Small secondary details in grey are fine but keep the three lines dominant. One small sun-yellow (#FFD23F) printed highlight on the "1 waiting" status.
Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no desk, no pens, no plants, no devices, no props, no logos. Calm, minimal, high-end print photography with natural paper texture.
